description:
Get the daily Brand Radar visibility trend for the property: one series ("visibility") of {date, value} points where value is the percentage (0-100) of tracked prompts whose AI-assistant answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) linked to the brand that day, ready for a time-series chart. Also returns "points" (number of days in range) and "insufficient_history" (true when too few points to chart meaningfully). Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Daily AI-visibility trend over the last 3 months.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_3_months"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.
